creator: @tech.bit0
hook: Stop guessing what looks good on you: shortcut prompts that tell you your best glasses, clothing colors and haircut from one selfie
why_it_worked: Personal, instantly testable payoff (your own face), shopping/salon use case, 'save for later' framing; prompts shown on screen so viewers save instead of comment.
how_we_adapt: Carousel 'Stop guessing at work': 3 prompts that read your resume/LinkedIn photo/email tone and tell you what to fix (best headline, best tone, best photo crop). Before/after slides + copy-paste prompt on the last slide.
metric_note: views from TikTok profile grid; creator's typical video ~5–50k

creator: @tech.bit0
hook: What if you could understand a book faster and actually remember it? Prompt shortcuts that turn any book into mind maps, flashcards and summaries
why_it_worked: Learning/self-improvement promise with tangible outputs (flashcards, mind map); one input → five formats feels like a cheat code.
how_we_adapt: Reel/carousel 'Turn any 40-page report into 5 things your boss actually reads': exec summary, 1-slide visual, FAQ, action list, flashcards for the meeting. One prompt per output.

creator: @cindiezhu
hook: From one ordinary photo against a wall to a moody cinematic street edit — two prompts
why_it_worked: Strong visual before/after, exactly 2 steps (ChatGPT storyboard → Google Flow video), viewer can repeat with their own photo in minutes. Her typical video gets ~1–5k, so this is a clear outlier.
how_we_adapt: 'Two prompts' format for work: 'From messy meeting notes to a polished client recap — two prompts' (prompt 1 structures, prompt 2 rewrites in client voice). Show raw → result side by side.
metric_note: views from TikTok profile grid; typical ~1–5k

creator: @cindiezhu
hook: All six of these video edits came from typing one code into Claude
why_it_worked: 'Codes' framing (/tier-list, /captions, /freeze-frame) makes a complex MCP setup feel like a cheat sheet; ~30–60× her typical views on that day.
how_we_adapt: Carousel 'Slash-codes for your workday': /tldr, /reply-polite, /meeting-agenda, /excel-formula, /prioritize — each slide = code + the hidden prompt it expands to (we teach people to save these as custom instructions/snippets).
metric_note: views from TikTok profile grid; ratio vs followers, ~30× vs her typical

creator: @darveloff
hook: Comment a keyword and I'll DM you the link — the biggest paid AI plan may be free for 6 months if you contribute to open source
why_it_worked: Money-saving news + keyword-to-DM CTA: ~21.2k comments, ~3k shares, ~3.1k likes visible. Claim is the creator's — not verified by us.
how_we_adapt: 'Free AI perks most people miss' carousel (only officially verified offers: student/education plans, free tiers) + 'Comment FREE' CTA that sends Starter 10. Verify each perk on the official page before posting.
metric_note: views from profile Reels tab; likes 3,144 / comments ~21.2k / shares 3,044 visible; typical reel ~10k

creator: @darveloff
hook: 'Claude killed MCPs' — a free GitHub tool that lets the agent control almost any app
why_it_worked: Provocative 'X killed Y' cover + nuanced caption ('MCPs aren't dead') + keyword DM for the repo; 1,874 likes, 2,037 comments, 1,870 shares.
how_we_adapt: Cover formula 'ChatGPT just killed your [boring task]' (e.g. weekly report). Inside: the honest nuance + 3-step workflow. Keep claims accurate.

creator: @valentumlabs
hook: Save these 7 ChatGPT prompts — I was stuck at 200 views per reel until I handed my Instagram to ChatGPT
why_it_worked: Personal transformation story (quit tech job, 200 views → 1M) + full prompts in caption + 'Comment SETUP' DM; 998 comments, 825 shares.
how_we_adapt: Story-led reel: 'I was spending 2 hours a day on email until I gave ChatGPT these 5 prompts' — numbers only if true for us; prompts in caption, 'Comment PROMPTS' → Starter 10.
metric_note: views from profile Reels tab; typical reel ~8–80k

creator: @isha.bytes
hook: Stop scrolling — 100 ChatGPT photo-editing commands you need to save (one dense cheat-sheet image)
why_it_worked: Mega cheat-sheet (100 short codes in one grid) = pure save/share bait: 13.7k likes and 5.6k shares on a 7.3k account whose reels average ~1–2k views. Comments are mostly 'Prompt' requests.
how_we_adapt: '50 ChatGPT commands for work' cheat-sheet carousel: one dense, readable grid per category (email, Excel, meetings, career), our brand colors, CTA 'save + comment WORK for the full PDF'.
metric_note: likes/shares visible on post; views not visible for carousels; ratio = likes/followers

creator: @george.automates
hook: 10 YouTube videos to master Claude in one weekend — save this
why_it_worked: Curated free-learning list + time promise ('one weekend'); ~10× his typical 1–4k views. Same week his 'Which AI myth do you still believe' got 26.9k.
how_we_adapt: 'Learn AI for your job in one weekend: 7 free official courses' carousel (only official sources: OpenAI Academy, Google, Anthropic), save CTA.
metric_note: views from TikTok profile grid; ~10× typical

creator: @maverickgpt (BIG, 639k)
hook: What happens when you ask Claude to make your Wi-Fi 10 times faster?
why_it_worked: Big account noted only: 'What happens when you ask AI to…' experiment format did ~25–50× his recent 2–5k average.
how_we_adapt: Series 'What happens when you ask ChatGPT to…' — '…rewrite your resume like a recruiter', '…find the hidden fees in your contract'. Screen-record the chat.
metric_note: big account; ratio vs followers low, vs own recent typical ~25×

creator: @longliveai (BIG, 1M)
hook: Stop telling ChatGPT 'analyze this' or 'give me ideas' — 10 prompts that make it a thinking partner
why_it_worked: Big account noted only: 'stop saying X, say Y' contrast + 20.2k comments via comment-to-get mechanic.
how_we_adapt: 'Stop typing X → type this' bad vs good prompt slides for work tasks.
metric_note: big account; likes 44,693 / comments 20,225 visible; outlier ratio not computed
